aggregation: Mean of five paired draws within task, then equal task mean within dataset; no pooling.

units.count_fields: mean count per task after averaging five draws, not pooled counts
units.evaluated: query-label denominator per task/draw; dataset value is its equal-task mean
units.task_sign_counts: number of tasks after averaging paired draw differences

scope.gate_100: Unlimited cap; disagreement, observed class and score > 0 still required.
scope.all_expert: All evaluated queries selected; no eligibility or score filter; changed counts only disagreement.
scope.five_percent_exact_original_replay: Verified by root replay; not verified by this report generator.
scope.best_grid_point: Descriptive observed maxima only; no new policy is selected.
